title: Fixed several `CustomBorders` bugs: borders now follow their cell when rows or columns are inserted, removed, or moved (and stay removable from the context menu afterward), and ranges defined with a top-level `border` object - including overlapping ranges - now render with the configured width, color, and style. Also added the `customBordersProgressive` option, which applies a large `customBorders` configuration in background batches so the grid renders immediately, together with the `afterCustomBordersUpdate` hook that fires once all custom borders have been applied.
